summary: Actual supervised N71 Linux RAM boot with new initramfs completed Z2 EE, E3/D9 twice, Type1 E7/D9, 9D/BF and AF automatically without manual sysfs writes. Operator touch capture: 4096 real EVDEV records, 581 SYN frames, 138 frames with two simultaneous active contacts; observed X 5..724/Y 14..1331 pixels; IRQ 1->935. Capture truncated by 4096-event cap (12 starts/10 releases not a release failure). Follow-up IRQ idle no-change for 4 seconds, USB stable. Latency, edge calibration and prolonged stability not yet verified.
